title: Fix unguarded last-admin removal via RemoveRole
description:
Fix unguarded last-admin removal via RemoveRole (Council-refined)

Source: audits/swarm-audit-synthesis-26-07-26.md

Problem: RemoveRole allows removing the last admin without adequate guardrails, risking admin lockout.

Acceptance criteria:
- Before removing an admin role, check if user is last admin; if so, require `--force` with explicit reason and audit log
- Add unit+integration tests covering remove-last-admin path
- Add UI guard (confirmation modal) for admin removal

Effort: 2-4h

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Audit synthesis corroboration: the redacted delta audit independently confirms the final active administrator invariant is not preserved by role removal. This is an exact overlap with the existing last-admin task; no duplicate task will be created.
